summary: Frontend-only mandatory pointer-routing retest completed on public preview after native document-capture Nav change. Routing remains non-deterministic for required pointer matrices and quick open-click, while keyboard routing, home origin, timeline lock/arrows, and gallery/quote/victory regressions passed. No error selectors and no horizontal overflow detected.

ui_bugs.issue: Failed 6/15 required pointer checks (9/15 pass). Repro examples: Legacy stuck at node 0 in run 1; Cars stuck at node 2 in runs 1 and 2; Tracks stuck at node 2 in run 1; Victories stuck at node 7 in run 2; Victories click detached during run 3.
Only 2/5 passed. Legacy remained node 0; Cars and Tracks remained node 2; Timeline and Victories passed.
Immediate open then Timeline click still lands at ORIGIN (active-node-0).

integration_issues.flow: Menu pointer click -> document capture route handler -> __spatialGo
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent route execution remains; same selector alternates between correct landing and stale node landing across fresh reloads. Also observed element detachment during Victories click while menu transitions.

action_items: Stabilize pointer routing transaction so every pointer click on Legacy/Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories deterministically dispatches and lands target node.
Fix quick open-click path so first click after menu open cannot fall back to ORIGIN.
Prevent menu-panel DOM detachment race during route click (observed on Victories) by sequencing close after confirmed route dispatch/commit.
After fix, rerun mandatory set: fresh matrix (3 runs), sequential matrix, quick open-click, keyboard Enter/Space, home origin, timeline lock/arrows, and gallery/quote/victory regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: Native capture listener is present, but setOpen(false) scheduled in same click transaction can still race with menu panel lifecycle and route-state updates under fast pointer interactions.
Routing validation is nearest-stop based; intermediate under-scroll/stale progression leaves active-node unchanged, exposing dispatch/commit timing gaps.
No evidence of global error boundary/runtime crash; issue scope is interaction sequencing and deterministic state commit, not general app stability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run fully executed mandatory scope on https://ui-revamp-dynamics.preview.emergentagent.com. PASS: keyboard Enter/Space routing, Home origin, timeline route + ArrowRight year shift + small-wheel lock, gallery next-scroll, quote next, victory year filter, no .error selectors, no horizontal overflow. FAIL: pointer determinism remains (fresh matrix 9/15, sequential 2/5) and quick open-click timeline fails to node 0. Trace run showed intermittent route invocation plus one menu-button click targeting hero-image and one Victories click detached during panel transition.
rca of the issue: Repro: 1) Reload and run pointer clicks for Legacy/Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories. 2) Observe changing outcomes across runs without code changes. 3) In quick open-click, Timeline often remains node 0. 4) In one run, Victories element detached while clicking. Root cause likely residual race between capture-click route dispatch, menu transition/close lifecycle, and spatial active-node commit timing. Mitigation: serialize route dispatch and menu close as one deterministic state machine (dispatch -> confirm commit -> close), and guard against click handling while panel is transitioning/detaching.
